title: Desman Stephens II returned to sideline after hit that sent Dante Moore to the hospital

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Desman Stephens II returned to sideline after hit that sent Dante Moore to the hospital
sources.description: Saturday night's game between Oregon and USC included a hit from Trojans linebacker Desman Stephens II that knocked out Ducks quarterback Dante Moore and sent him to the hospital.
